paragraphs.text: Citizen is a creature type depicting inhabitants of a city or town, usually in a non-fighting capacity.
Citizens were introduced in Fallen Empires , were only reused twice in Time Spiral , and for a long time only appeared on tokens .

The first card to use the type is Five Kids in a Trenchcoat , which was a playtest card from the Mystery Booster set. The first two black-bordered cards with the type were Prosperous Innkeeper and Skullport Merchant from Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms .
Citizen tribal was used as the limited draft archetype of Streets of New Capenna , though Citizens would also appear in other colors. After that, they regularly appeared on other planes as well.
